chapter_or_section: Overfit and underfit > Combined L2 + dropout
title: Combined L2 + dropout
instruction_text: Both L2 regularization and dropout improve the behavior of the large model, but this still does not beat the Tiny baseline. Next, try them both together and see whether the combined model performs better.
starter_code:
combined_model = tf.keras.Sequential([
    layers.Dense(512, kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.0001), activation='elu', input_shape=(FEATURES,)),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(512, kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.0001), activation='elu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(512, kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.0001), activation='elu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(512, kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.0001), activation='elu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(1)
])

regularizer_histories['combined'] = compile_and_fit(combined_model, 'regularizers/combined')
learning_objectives: Apply L2 regularization in a tf.keras model.
Add Dropout layers to reduce overfitting.
Compare combined regularization against earlier model variants in the tutorial.
course_context: Overfit and underfit > Combined L2 + dropout

source_title: TensorFlow tutorial: Overfit and underfit > Strategies to prevent overfitting > Add weight regularization
chapter_or_section: TensorFlow tutorial: Overfit and underfit > Strategies to prevent overfitting > Add weight regularization
title: Add weight regularization
instruction_text: Add L2 weight regularization to the large baseline network and compare its behavior against the earlier unregularized models. In tf.keras, weight regularization is added by passing regularizer instances to layers as keyword arguments. Add L2 weight regularization and train the resulting model using the same compile_and_fit procedure as before.
starter_code:
l2_model = tf.keras.Sequential([
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu',
                 kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.001),
                 input_shape=(FEATURES,)),
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu',
                 kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.001)),
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu',
                 kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.001)),
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu',
                 kernel_regularizer=regularizers.l2(0.001)),
    layers.Dense(1)
])

regularizer_histories['l2'] = compile_and_fit(l2_model, 'regularizers/l2')
expected_output: A trained L2-regularized model and comparison plots or observations showing that the regularized model behaves more competitively with the Tiny baseline and is more resistant to overfitting than the unregularized Large model.
constraints: Use the same training configuration and compile_and_fit procedure as earlier models in the tutorial.
Apply L2 regularization through the kernel_regularizer argument.
Compare the resulting learning behavior against the earlier baseline models.
learning_objectives: Apply L2 weight regularization in tf.keras.
Compare regularized and unregularized training behavior.
Relate weight decay to improved generalization and reduced overfitting.
course_context: TensorFlow tutorial: Overfit and underfit > Strategies to prevent overfitting > Add weight regularization
notes: Finalized from an official TensorFlow tutorial section with a clear contiguous task and explicit starter code.

source_title: TensorFlow tutorial: Overfit and underfit > Strategies to prevent overfitting > Add dropout
chapter_or_section: TensorFlow tutorial: Overfit and underfit > Strategies to prevent overfitting > Add dropout
title: Add dropout
instruction_text: Add dropout layers to the large baseline network to examine how dropout reduces overfitting. In Keras, introduce dropout through tf.keras.layers.Dropout, applied to the output of the preceding layer. Add dropout layers to the network and train the resulting model using the same compile_and_fit procedure as before.
starter_code:
dropout_model = tf.keras.Sequential([
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu', input_shape=(FEATURES,)),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(512, activation='elu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(1)
])

regularizer_histories['dropout'] = compile_and_fit(dropout_model, 'regularizers/dropout')
expected_output: A trained dropout-regularized model and comparison plots or observations showing improved behavior relative to the unregularized Large model.
constraints: Use the same training configuration and compile_and_fit procedure as earlier models in the tutorial.
Compare the resulting model against the Tiny baseline and earlier regularization variants.
learning_objectives: Apply dropout in tf.keras to reduce overfitting.
Compare dropout-based regularization against baseline training behavior.
Interpret how dropout changes generalization behavior in a large network.
course_context: TensorFlow tutorial: Overfit and underfit > Strategies to prevent overfitting > Add dropout
notes: Finalized from an official TensorFlow tutorial section with a clear contiguous task and explicit starter code.
